body.x: DJI(www.dji.com) releases drone camera Inspire1 at CES Unveiled, a pre-show of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.Inspire1 gives a full 360⁰ unobstructed view with movable carbon fiber arm. The 4K camera provides 12 megapixel picture and 24-30 fps 4K videos. The camera can be controlled with a mobile app, and two remote controllers enables the separate control of the camera and movement.
